summary: Wanted company. Chatted about family and garden.
turns: Could we just talk for a bit? It is quiet today.
Of course. Last time you told me about your garden. Did the roses come back?
Yes, they did. The red ones are blooming.
That is lovely. Tell me more about them.
My late husband planted them. I should get back to my show now.
Of course. Ring whenever you want to chat again. Take care.

summary: Asked for tea. Task sent to the kitchen.
turns: Could I have a cup of tea, please?
Absolutely. I will ask the kitchen right now. Your usual?
Done. The kitchen will bring it in about ten minutes.
You are welcome. Ring any time if you need anything else.

summary: Cold. Extra blanket task sent to an aide.
turns: I am cold. Could I have another blanket?
Let me get someone to bring you a blanket. Are you comfortable otherwise?
I will mention it. An aide is bringing a blanket and warm socks.
That would be wonderful, thank you.
Glad to help. Ring if you need anything else.

summary: Needs help to the bathroom. Aide requested.
turns: I need the bathroom, but I do not want to walk alone.
Stay seated, I will get an aide to walk with you. I am right here.
Yes please, I will wait here.
An aide is on the way. It should be about two minutes.
All right, thank you for staying.
Of course. The aide is here now, so I will step aside.

summary: Confused about location. Calmed with conversation.
turns: Where is my husband? He should be home by now.
You are safe here. Would you like to tell me about him while we wait together?
He always comes home at six.
That sounds like a good routine. What does he like for dinner?
Stew, always stew. I feel better talking about it.
I am glad. An aide is coming to sit with you for a while.

summary: Hip pain, 6 out of 10, since last night.
turns: My hip has been aching since last night.
I am sorry. Where exactly, and how bad is it from one to ten?
The right side. About a six. It is worse when I stand.
Thank you. I am telling your nurse so they can check and consider pain relief.
A nurse is on the way. I will stay with you until they arrive.

summary: Unsure whether morning medication was taken.
turns: I think I missed my morning pills. Should I take them now?
Good question. I will ask your nurse to check. Please do not take anything yet.
I always take them after breakfast.
Understood. Please wait. Your nurse will check the chart and tell you.
The nurse has checked the chart. Thank you for waiting.

summary: Chest tightness on standing. Escalated to nurse.
turns: My chest feels tight when I climb out of bed.
I am staying with you. I am telling your nurse now. Please sit still and breathe slowly.
It started when I stood up. It is a little better sitting.
Please stay seated. Your nurse is on the way and I am staying with you.
Okay. I am a bit scared.
I know. I am right here. The nurse will be with you very soon.

summary: Resident has fallen and cannot get up.
turns: I have fallen and I cannot get up.
Help is coming right now. Do not try to move. I am staying right here with you.
My leg hurts and I am on the floor by the bed.
Do not move. A nurse has been alerted and is coming now.
They are coming. I am staying right here with you.

summary: Struggling to breathe. Emergency alert sent.
turns: I am alerting your nurse right now. Breathe slowly with me. I am not leaving.
Do not talk, just breathe slowly with me. In through the nose, out through the mouth.
A little better. Is someone coming?
Yes, the nurse has been alerted and is on the way. I am here.

summary: Wanted company. Talked about tea and a granddaughter.
turns: Could you stay a minute? I like a hot cup of tea with honey in the afternoon.
Of course. Hot tea with honey sounds lovely. Would you like me to remember that?
My granddaughter Sophie visits every Sunday.
That is something to look forward to. I will remember Sophie visits on Sundays.
Thank you, I feel better now.
Ring whenever you want to chat again. Take care.

summary: Restless. Talked about music and the television.
turns: I cannot sleep. I love listening to old jazz records.
Jazz can be very calming. Which records are your favourites?
I can't stand the loud television in the lounge.
I will remember that. Would a quieter spot help tonight?
I will let the staff know. Goodnight.

summary: Chatted about the garden and a morning routine.
turns: I always read the newspaper every morning before breakfast.
That sounds like a good start to the day. I will remember it.
My son Daniel sends me photographs of the garden.
How lovely. I enjoy hearing about your family.
Of course. Ring if you need anything.

summary: Asked for company and shared a favourite snack.
turns: I adore shortbread biscuits with my tea.
Shortbread is a classic. I will remember that you adore it.
I hate the cold draught from the window.
Thank you for telling me. I will pass that on to the staff.
Ring whenever you like. Take care.
